assignment.title: The Sorting Ceremony | Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
assignment.instructions: Listen attentively to the audio track. You have a maximum of 2 listens. When you are ready, answer all 10 Cambridge Stage 6 comprehension questions.

questions.question: Which house is Susan Bones sorted into?
questions.explanation: In the transcript, right after Susan Bones is called, the Sorting Hat shouts 'Hufflepuff!'.

questions.question: What object is placed on the students' heads to sort them into houses?
questions.explanation: The teacher states: 'I shall place the Sorting Hat on your head, and you will be sorted into your houses.'

questions.question: Who is sorted into Gryffindor right after the Sorting Hat says, 'Ha! Another Weasley'?
questions.explanation: The transcript shows: 'Ronald Weasley! Ha! Another Weasley. I know just what to do with you. Gryffindor!'

questions.question: In the teacher's instruction 'you will come forth', what does the word 'forth' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Come forth' is a formal phrase meaning to step forward or come to the front.

questions.question: Ron says Hermione is 'Mental, that one'. What does 'mental' mean in this informal context?
questions.explanation: In British informal speech, calling someone 'mental' means they are acting crazy, strange, or wild.

questions.question: The Sorting Hat says Harry has a 'thirst to prove yourself'. What does 'thirst' mean in this sentence?
options: A strong desire or eager wish
questions.explanation: Here, 'thirst' is used metaphorically to mean a deep desire or eagerness to show one's abilities.

questions.question: Why does Harry repeatedly whisper 'Not Slytherin, not Slytherin'?
options: He wants to join his family in Slytherin.
He believes all dark or bad wizards belonged to Slytherin.
He thinks Slytherin is for older students only.
He was told Slytherin house has no room left.
questions.explanation: Earlier in the clip, Ron remarks that 'There's not a witch or wizard who went bad who wasn't in Slytherin', influencing Harry's strong reluctance to be placed there.

questions.question: What can we infer about the Sorting Hat's reaction to Ronald Weasley?
options: It finds Ron very confusing and difficult to place.
It instantly recognizes his family traits and knows where he belongs.
It wants to place Ron into Slytherin house.
It has never sorted a member of the Weasley family before.
questions.explanation: By saying 'Ha! Another Weasley. I know just what to do with you,' the Hat shows it immediately recognizes the family and knows they belong in Gryffindor.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the ceremony in this clip?
options: To give out academic awards to students
To test the magical strength of new wizards
To divide new students into school houses
To choose a class leader for the year
questions.explanation: The main event described is placing the Sorting Hat on new students to sort them into Gryffindor, Slytherin, Hufflepuff, or Ravenclaw.

questions.question: What tone does the Sorting Hat use when talking to Harry Potter?
questions.explanation: The Hat carefully considers Harry's mind ('Hmmm... difficult, very difficult') and gently tries to persuade him ('Slytherin will help you on the way to greatness... Are you sure?').
